# Yusr Collection

> Yusr Collection is a premium Islamic streetwear brand from Mumbai, India, making modest, faith-led oversized tees in 240 GSM heavyweight cotton with made-to-order DTF prints.

- Website: https://yusrcollection.store
- Brand name: Yusr Collection (stylised as YŪSR Collection)
- Category: Premium Islamic / modest streetwear — currently a single category, Tees
- Market: India (ships pan-India)
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 9326184407 (10:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST) · yusrrcollections@gmail.com
- Social: Instagram https://www.instagram.com/yusrcollection29 · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/yusrcollection

## About Us

Yusr (pronounced "Yoo-sr") means "ease" and "aasani". Yusr Collection was founded to fill a gap in streetwear: a brand that feels premium and looks bold on the street, yet stays completely true to Islamic identity and modesty.

- Every piece is **made-to-order** and custom-printed specifically for the customer — this is not fast fashion.
- Fabric: **240 GSM heavyweight cotton**, chosen for a structured, premium hand-feel and breathability.
- Fit: **unisex oversized, drop-shoulder** with extra body length.
- Printing: **DTF (Direct-to-Film) printing**, producing sharp, durable graphics that do not fade easily.
- Sizes offered: **S, M, L, XL, XXL**.
- Design language: faith-led typography, Arabic calligraphy and heritage graphics, in a restrained premium palette.
- Fulfilment: printed and dispatched through the brand's centralized print partner (Qikink). There is no physical walk-in store; all support is digital.

Key specifications shared by every product: **240 GSM**, **oversized drop-shoulder**, **unisex fit**, **DTF Print**, **100% cotton** (except the Live Like Ali tee, which is a 240 GSM premium oversized fit), **made-to-order**.

## Size Guide & Fit

All Yusr Collection tees have an **oversized, drop-shoulder fit** with extra body length and a relaxed shoulder line. The fit is intentionally boxy and roomy.

- **Important:** If you prefer a regular, non-oversized fit, or you are between two sizes, **size down**.
- Please check the size chart on the product page before ordering. Exchanges are handled on a best-effort basis (see Returns & Exchanges).

Measurements (inches):

| Size | Chest | Length | Shoulder | Sleeve |
| ---- | ----- | ------ | -------- | ------ |
| S    | 42"   | 28"    | 21"      | 8.5"   |
| M    | 44"   | 29"    | 22"      | 9.0"   |
| L    | 46"   | 30"    | 23"      | 9.5"   |
| XL   | 48"   | 31"    | 24"      | 10.0"  |
| XXL  | 50"   | 32"    | 25"      | 10.5"  |

## Shipping & Delivery

- **Pan-India shipping** — Yusr Collection delivers across India via premium couriers.
- **Free shipping on all prepaid orders.** COD orders carry standard courier charges.
- **Estimated delivery time: 10–14 days.** Each piece is made to order: printing and packing takes 3–5 business days, and shipping then takes 7–9 days.
- Orders receive a confirmation message on placing the order, and a courier tracking link by email and WhatsApp once dispatched.
- Orders can be tracked any time at https://yusrcollection.store/track-order using the order number.

## Returns & Exchanges

- **Size exchange (allowed, one time):** the request must be raised within **48 hours of delivery**. The item must be unused, unwashed, and have all original tags intact. The customer bears the cost of shipping the item back; Yusr Collection covers shipping the new size out.
- **Damaged or defective item (free replacement):** damaged, torn or misprinted items are replaced free of charge. A **continuous unboxing video is mandatory**, showing the shipping label and the defect clearly. Without an unboxing video, damage claims cannot be processed.
- **No refunds for change of mind:** no monetary refunds are offered. Only size exchanges and replacements for defects are available, so please check the size chart before ordering.
- **Order cancellation:** orders can only be cancelled within **12 hours** of being placed. Once printing begins (usually within 24 hours), cancellation is not possible because the product is custom-made.
- **How to raise a request:** WhatsApp **+91 9326184407** with your Order ID and the unboxing video (if applicable) within the stated time frame. Full policy: https://yusrcollection.store/returns

## Payment Methods

- **Prepaid (recommended):** secure online checkout via **Razorpay** — UPI, credit/debit cards and net banking. Prepaid orders get an instant **₹50 discount**, priority dispatch, and **free shipping**.
- **Cash on Delivery (COD):** available across India.
- Card and UPI details are never stored by Yusr Collection; payments are processed by the PCI-DSS compliant Razorpay gateway.
